one_line: Rajput regent of Mewar who led the defence of Chittor during Bahadur Shah of Gujarat’s siege in 1535 CE.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s to early 30s, slender but sturdy build, with the poised bearing of a queen who has endured war and court politics.
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, medium-full lips, sharp dark eyebrows and large expressive brown eyes; wheatish Rajput complexion; a small tilak at the centre of her forehead; default expression is calm, resolute focus with a hint of underlying sorrow.
appearance.hair: Long, straight black hair parted in the middle, fully covered by a rich veil (odhni) drawn forward over her head and pinned; the veil edge is slightly lowered at the brow like a modest Rajput queen, with just a few neat strands visible at the temples.
appearance.costume: She wears a 16th‑century Rajput royal ensemble: a deep crimson lehenga (long flared skirt) in heavy woven silk with narrow gold border and subtle floral motifs, a matching fitted choli (blouse) completely covered by a long-sleeved, knee-length golden-beige angarkha-style over-tunic that crosses left over right and ties at the side, and a sheer but opaque odhni (veil) in saffron-orange with a thin green-gold border draped over her head and around her shoulders; she has a pearl-and-gold nath (nose ring with a fine chain to the hair), small gold jhumka earrings, layered pearl and kundan necklaces, a simple gold mangalsutra strand, broad gold bangles and a few red glass bangles, and a slim gold kamarband (waist belt) over the angarkha; her feet are in brown leather mojari shoes peeking from under the lehenga.
appearance.signature: A sheathed Rajput talwar with a slightly curved steel blade and disc pommel, carried at her left hip on a dark brown leather belt; the scabbard is plain dark-red leather with minimal brass fittings, and she often rests one hand lightly on the hilt to show resolve.

ref_desc: Rani Karnavati is a wheatish-complexioned Rajput queen in her early 30s with large brown eyes, a tilak, black hair covered by a saffron-orange odhni, wearing a deep crimson silk lehenga, golden-beige angarkha, rich jewellery and brown mojari, carrying a plain dark-red sheathed Rajput talwar at her left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Rani Karnavati of Mewar: a dignified Rajput queen in her early 30s with an oval wheatish face, straight nose, large serious brown eyes, sharp brows and a small tilak on her forehead, her long black hair fully covered by a saffron-orange odhni whose bordered edge frames her brow. She wears a deep crimson silk lehenga with a narrow gold border and subtle floral texture, a matching fitted choli completely hidden beneath a long-sleeved knee-length golden-beige angarkha that wraps left over right and ties at the side, and the odhni draped over her head and around her shoulders in modest Rajput style. Adorn her with a pearl-and-gold nath with a fine chain to her hair, small gold jhumka earrings, layered pearl and kundan necklaces including a simple mangalsutra-like strand, broad gold and red glass bangles, and a slim gold kamarband at her waist; put simple brown leather mojari shoes just visible under the hem of her lehenga. At her left hip, on a dark brown leather belt, hang her signature slightly curved Rajput talwar in a plain dark-red leather scabbard with minimal brass fittings, her right hand resting lightly on the hilt as she stands tall and composed. Use a limited palette of deep crimson red, saffron orange, golden beige, emerald green accents and dark brown leather, and show her from front, side and back to clearly display her consistent face, covered hair, layered garments, jewellery and sword placement.
